A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
